messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Yellowing of your skin or eyes is a sign of liver problems.
Yellowing of your skin or eyes is jaundice.
Triplet: ["Yellowing of your skin or eyes", "is a sign of", "liver problems"]

The relation 'is a sign of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition is an indicator or symptom of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'have': The subject group of patients has the medical condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
D. 'has severity': The medical condition or effect specified by the subject has the severity specified by the object entity.
E. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
